practices.practice: Tune vector-index algorithm and parameters to your data and tier: prefer DiskANN for large/production (M30+), HNSW for high-recall on M30+, IVF for small/test datasets; tune numLists (IVF), M and efConstruction (HNSW), and lBuild/lSearch/maxDegree (DiskANN).
